description: Embed the stored graphics pages (charts, org charts, diagrams found while ingesting PDFs) of a context as image vectors, so text questions also find them (image search). Background job; by default only pages without a vector of the context's model, reembed=true recomputes all. Needs a local ONNX embedding model with a vision encoder; otherwise it fails with the reason. Returns {job_id}; poll job_status (result: total, embedded, failed). Status first: page_image_status.

reembed.description: Recompute every page-image vector (default false: only missing ones).

name: embed_page_images
